# Shortify

> Shortify is a fast, free, secure, and modern URL Shortener web application.

Shortify enables users and AI agents to transform long URLs into clean, manageable short links, generate instant QR codes, and monitor link analytics.

## Core Features
- URL Shortening: Convert long, complex URLs into short, shareable links.
- Custom Aliases: Create personalized slugs for branded links.
- QR Code Generation: Instantly generate QR codes for any shortened link.
- Link Analytics: Track total clicks, creation date, and last accessed timestamp.
- Link Expiration: Set optional expiration periods in days.

## API Documentation
- `POST /api/shorten`: Create a new short URL.
  - Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`
  - Body:
    - `originalUrl` (string, required): The target URL (must include http:// or https://).
    - `customAlias` (string, optional): Desired custom short code (alphanumeric, 4-20 chars).
    - `expiresIn` (number, optional): Link expiry duration in days (1-365).
  - Response: JSON object containing `shortUrl`, `shortCode`, `originalUrl`, and `createdAt`.

- `GET /api/stats/:shortCode`: Get analytics for a shortened URL.
  - Parameters: `shortCode` (string, required).
  - Response: JSON object containing `originalUrl`, `clicks`, `createdAt`, and `expiresAt`.

- `DELETE /api/url/:shortCode`: Delete a shortened URL.
  - Parameters: `shortCode` (string, required).

- `GET /:shortCode`: Redirect to the original destination URL.
